title: Mundari Samaj introduces its articles and community publishing hub
excerpt: The updated platform brings articles, news, community stories, a media gallery and a searchable knowledge hub into one place.
body: This is a platform announcement. The new editorial structure is designed to make community knowledge easier to discover.

title: Invitation: share language resources and community histories
excerpt: We welcome carefully documented words, memories, photographs and references, shared with permission.
body: Contributors are invited to share material they have the right to provide. Include context, preferred credit and any restrictions.
